# Incomplete reference (REF002)

A reference with no resolvable target.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `ref-incomplete` |
| Family | referential |
| Applies to | `core` |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fix | `manual` |
| Evidence | RE |
| Sniffers | vale, llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

A pointer to something the reader cannot resolve. The pattern triggers; the model checks whether the target is actually findable.

Bad:  Follow the steps in the section above.
Good: Follow the steps in section 3.2 of this file.

Not a finding when the target is numbered or named unambiguously.

## Detector metadata

```yaml
- kind: vale
  pattern: \b(the (section|table|figure|file|diagram|list|steps?) (above|below)|as
    (previously|described above|mentioned above)|see (above|below)|the attached|the
    aforementioned)\b
  confidence: medium
  hook_safe: false
- kind: llm
  confidence: medium
  hook_safe: false
```
